d:
Enjoy this classic song 'Chhan Chhan Chhan Payal' sung by veteran singers Manna Dey and Lata Mangeshkar from 1962 Movie Maa Beta starring Manoj Kumar, Ameeta and Nirupa Roy in the lead. Maa Beta is Directed by Lekhraj Bhakri while the Music is composed by Hemant Kumar and Lyrics are penned by Prem Dhawan.
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar, Manna Dey
Music Director: Hemant Kumar
Lyricists: Prem Dhawan
Genre: Filmi
Album: Maa Beta
Year: 1962
